{{Quote|This is awful! Who will help my family?|[[Larence Zaprin]], to a medic|<ref name="SWG:HC" />}}
The '''Zaprin family''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] family that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Larence Zaprin]], his wife, his daughter [[Mia Zaprin|Mia]] and his son [[Jowres Zaprin|Jowres]] lived in the [[Zaprin Estate]] in the remote [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|mountain]] wilderness of Naboo.<ref name="SWG:HC" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the family's home was surrounded by sick animals and the siblings Mia und Jowres were attacked and infected with an illness. When Larence sent an urgent request for a [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]], a [[Medic/Legends|medic]] was sent to help the family. The medic was able to create an anti-toxin and cure the infected siblings.<ref name="SWG:HC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Zaprin family appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:HC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Zaprin family was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
